title: PSTNType
description:
* `LOCAL_GATEWAY` - PSTN connection type for a premises-based connection.
 * `NON_INTEGRATED_CCP` - PSTN connection type for a Non-Integrated Cloud Connected PSTN connection.
 * `INTEGRATED_CCP` - PSTN connection type for an Integrated Cloud Connected PSTN connection. Updating the location with this connection type is currently not supported using the API.
 * `CISCO_PSTN` - PSTN connection type for a Cisco PSTN connection. Updating the location with this connection type is currently not supported using the API.
